title.narrative: Support for Implementation of Components of the Development Initiative for Northern Uganda (DINU).

description.narrative: The general objective of the project is to consolidate stability in Northern Uganda, eradicate poverty and under-nutrition and strengthen the foundations for sustainable and inclusive socio-economic development.The specific objectives of the project implemented by UNCDF include:1.Improve access to finance for SMEs engaged in agricultural value addition through a dedicated facility for business development services and blended finance. 2.Improve the stock and quality of the district road assets through a district road rehabilitation fund and dedicated technical assistance and improve local service delivery for road assets.3.Increase local fiscal space and improve local service delivery through a discretionary grant mechanism and technical assistance to core government functions, including customary land tenure systems.

title.narrative: Increased local fiscal space and improved local service delivery through a discretionary grant mechanism and technical assistance to core government functions, including customary land tenure systems

description.narrative: This outcome is focused on improving the capacities of LGs to manage core public financial processes and strengthen the systems to improve service delivery and local development. This is delivered through support to local revenue management and administration, support for economic infrastructure projects through the Local Government Excellence Fund (LGEF), assets management support, improvement in PFM practices and partnerships with the LG associations to introduce alternative financing mechanisms.

description.narrative: This outcome is focused on improving the capacities of LGs to manage core public financial processes and strengthen the systems to improve service delivery and local development. This is delivered through support to local revenue management and administration, support for economic infrastructure projects through the Local Government Excellence Fund (LGEF), assets management support, improvement in PFM practices and partnerships with the LG associations to introduce alternative financing mechanisms.
